original_source.archive_encoding: Concatenate archive_parts in listed order; bytes equal the original supplied PDF.

sheet.kind: production drawing: one sheet with twelve 130x185 mm manual panels, a title block, a revision table and production notes

panel_grid.reading_order: left to right, top row then bottom row; panels 3-12 carry folios 01-10, matching the printed contents
panel_grid.sides: top row = sheet front, bottom row = back (正反面印刷, 折页); the printed contents and folios confirm the set is complete

panels.reason: Printed cover: model badge, product image, title, support pill and the four お買い上げ notes. Operator: 「封面和目录 不用体现在web版面上」.
Printed contents 01-10; the Web navigation carries the chapters.

sheet_regions.reason: Drawing-frame zone letters A-P and numbers 1-11 on the sheet border.
Revision table: 版次 V0.1 第一次发行 and its empty sign-off columns.
Title block: 产品名称 HTP0113600A, 语言/国家 JP, 产品料号 16-0102-000060, 版本 V0.1, 页数 01, drafter, date 2025-12-8 and packaging tolerances.
Production notes: part title and RoHS/REACH, 成品尺寸 130*185mm, 80g书纸 正反面印刷, 90%黑, 装订方式 折页.

normalizations: Production sheet: the twelve 130x185 mm panels are read as pages in panel-local points; panel 1 (cover), panel 2 (contents) and the sheet's frame grid, title block, revision table and production notes are classified and excluded (source/ja/coverage.json).
Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components (callout strip, warning lockup, reference figure, inbox, warranty lead and sections).

Print line breaks: at a Japanese junction a wrapped line joins without a space; a line the print ended at least one em short after closing punctuation, or three ems short anywhere, keeps its line break (logged in source/ja/coverage.json).
Print weights: bold print runs stay strong; headings keep the print's band levels (chapter bands h2, sub-bands and bulleted subheads h3).
Lists: ・ bullets and numbered print items become unordered or ordered lists; ※ and * notes stay printed paragraphs; the 保証内容 numbered subheads stay bold paragraphs, as printed.
Tables keep the print's structure; only the troubleshooting table has a printed header row.
Two visible marks drawn as outlines (UN38.3, the ■ before the p03 notice) are restored from source/text-recovery.json; heading disc markers and pills are left to the shared heading style.

Labelled figures are text-free art (printed label lines removed with the redact_text operator, 4x raster) with those lines as live Japanese copy on their print positions; other artwork words stay in the art; no figure carries a visible caption.
Troubleshooting uses the shared troubleshooting table (JBP-2000B reference); tables the shared components would change (signal, LCD, symbols, specifications) stay native grids, as printed.

validation_boundary.build_py_check: Existing JE-1000F/US fixture regression only; does not validate JBP-3600A/JP or register it in phase2.
